concepts.label: 한국 설 — 색동 한복
concepts.design: Costume: Korean Seollal festive HANBOK, culturally recognizable jeogori-and-chima construction. Soft ivory short jeogori jacket with a crisp white dongjeong collar, cheerful saekdong multicolor striped sleeves in soft rose, sky blue, pale yellow and jade, a neatly tied coral goreum ribbon, rich jade-teal full chima skirt ending just above the ankles so cream beoseon socks and tiny traditional embroidered floral shoes are visible. Small lemon-gold norigae pendant and a coral bokjumeoni drawstring lucky pouch lightly held in one hand; other hand relaxed. Blonde hair loose, a small tasteful matching ribbon accent, lemon clip clearly visible. Warm greeting smile. A fresh cheerful Korean New Year outfit, not a kimono, not hanfu; no obi or Chinese-style standing collar.

Asset type: full-body seasonal costume concept art for an existing animated OBS mascot.
Input image 1 is ONLY the character identity and rendering-style reference. Replace the entire witch costume with the seasonal costume described below.
Subject invariants: the SAME cute female chibi character, long softly wavy blonde hair, large warm amber eyes, distinctive lemon-wedge hair clip on viewer RIGHT, same face and chibi proportions. Polished clean anime illustration with delicate warm outlines, soft dimensional shading and clear fabric details, matching the reference's rendering quality. Keep her recognizably the same character, not a new person.

No witch hat, no witch cape, no potion belt, no lab coat, no Halloween items. No scene, ground, drop shadow, swatches, panels, labels, text, logos or watermark. No duplicated character, no extra limbs.

concepts.label: 크리스마스 — 레몬 산타
concepts.design: Costume: cozy Christmas helper in a deep cranberry-red Santa capelet with fluffy ivory trim, cream knit sweater, forest-green pleated skirt, opaque warm ivory tights and red-brown fur-trimmed ankle boots. Soft red Santa hat with an ivory pom-pom sits lightly on the blonde hair without hiding her lemon clip. Small lemon-gold bell clasp, subtle green bow, simple readable silhouette. Holds one small cream gift box with a green ribbon at her side with one hand; other hand slightly open in welcome. Gentle festive smile. Keep outfit warm and wholesome, no exposed midriff, no weapon, no staff.

concepts.label: 어린이날 — 노란 모자와 멜빵
concepts.design: Costume: cheerful Korean Children's Day picnic/play outfit: rounded bright lemon-yellow sun hat with a short brim and tiny lemon badge, ivory short-sleeve T-shirt, sky-blue denim short overalls with large yellow buttons and a small lemon embroidery patch on the front bib, white ankle socks and rounded yellow canvas sneakers. Small coral-red backpack with shoulder straps visible, her long blonde hair flowing outside the straps and lemon clip visible under the hat. Holds a small colorful paper pinwheel at her side, positioned away from the face, other hand relaxed. Playful open smile. Clean toy-like color accents, not school uniform, no writing or brands.

concepts.label: 여름휴가 — 밀짚모자와 바캉스룩
concepts.design: Costume: relaxed summer seaside vacation outfit, natural woven straw sun hat with turquoise ribbon, open aqua Hawaiian shirt with sparse simple lemon-and-leaf motifs over a plain cream T-shirt, coral-orange knee-length shorts, brown comfortable sandals. Small round sunglasses tucked on the hat brim, never over the eyes. A small woven beach tote with a folded striped towel hangs low from one relaxed hand without covering the outfit. Long blonde hair, visible lemon hair clip, bright amber eyes, sunny relaxed smile. Breezy practical holiday clothing; no swimsuit, no bikini, no beach scenery, no giant props.
